subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should the iOS preview-tour first-run experience be rebased and adopted on top of current main, narrowed to a smaller follow-up, or paused/closed?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not only mechanical: this PR adds a new preview/sample onboarding mode while current main has since landed overlapping onboarding, routing, and typography decisions.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, preserved configured-gateway routing, and fresh first-run/configured-user proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to preview-only follow-up
options.body: Extract only the sample-preview pieces maintainers still want and leave connection/setup-code work to the focused mobile pairing PRs.

options.title: Pause or close branch
options.body: Treat current main's onboarding refresh as the maintained direction if the preview-tour product surface is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, preserved configured-gateway routing, and fresh first-run/configured-user proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent configured-gateway startup routing fix is on the same decision boundary and gives the clearest current-main routing ownership signal.
